title: 第3章 夫人您认错人了第4章 这谁还能顶得住
slug: 救了元婴宗主夫人醒后她急了

;;
“无尘……”
极其轻微的两个字，从她喉咙最深处幽幽飘了出来。轻得像是一抹稍纵即逝的叹息，却又实打实地裹挟着一股浓得化不开的痴缠与委屈，甚至还藏着几分幽怨。
陆长生整个人如同被九天玄雷劈中，浑身的血液瞬间冷了下去，僵在原地一动不敢动。
无尘？剑无尘？那位常年闭死关、神龙见首不见尾的天剑宗宗主？！
稍一转念，陆长生只觉得后脖颈一阵发凉，头皮瞬间炸开。屋子里没点灯，自己又是背光站在门边，只能勉强看出个高大的人影轮廓。
再加上自己这副身形，确实和主殿里挂着的那副宗主画像有几分相似。
柳师师此刻已经被逆乱的阴阳二气冲昏了神智，在这非人的痛苦和幻觉交织下，把门口的黑影当成了她那个日思夜想的夫君，简直再正常不过！
但这该死的误会是会要人命的！
一股极寒的凉气顺着他的尾椎骨一路狂窜上天灵盖。
这要是真被这位姑奶奶当成了替身，等她事后清醒过来，或者被哪个起夜的长老撞见，他陆长生就算是有十条命都不够填的！绝对会被活活剥皮抽筋，神魂贬入九幽永不超生。
“不……不是！夫人，您再看清楚一点！”陆长生吓得嗓音都劈了叉，那调子听着比被掐住脖子的老鸭还要凄惨几分。
他双脚在地板上胡乱蹬蹭，拼了命地往后缩，恨不得把整个人都嵌进身后的门板里去，“我真的不是剑……”
然而，那后半截辩解还没来得及滚出喉咙，眼前的景象便骤然扭曲。
根本没有给他任何眨眼或是反应的余地，那是完全超出了肉眼捕捉极限的恐怖极速。
瘦死的骆驼比马大，哪怕是此刻神智迷乱、正处于走火入魔边缘的元婴期大能，其本能爆发出的身法，也绝非他这么一个还在炼气期摸爬滚打的底层蝼蚁所能窥探的。
陆长生只觉得眼前那一抹原本蜷缩的白影恍若鬼魅般一晃，原本还隔着数丈的距离瞬间被撕裂。
一阵混杂着幽兰冷香与滚烫热浪的香风，带着让人头晕目眩的窒息感，毫无征兆地欺到了他的鼻尖前。
下一瞬，巨大的阴影当头罩下。
都没等陆长生本能地抬起胳膊格挡，一具柔软得不可思议、却又烫得犹如刚出炉火炭般的娇躯，已经完全不讲道理地重重撞进了他的怀里。

“砰！”
这一撞的力道大得惊人，陆长生整个人被撞得向后倒飞，后背结结实实地砸在了那硬木门框上。
五脏六腑仿佛都在这一刻移了位，震得他差点没背过气去，连肺里的空气都被硬生生挤了出来。
“你终于肯出关了……你知道我等你等得有多辛苦吗？”
陆长生刚想张嘴，费劲地挤出一句：“夫人，我……”
可柳师师哪里还会给他半个字的解释机会。
她那双手原本因痛苦而死死抓挠着地毯，指尖早已血肉模糊，此刻却像是溺水濒死之人终于抓住了一根救命的浮木，带着一股令人窒息的力道，死死地环住了陆长生的脖颈。
她整个人几乎是完全挂在他身上的，双脚甚至因为脱力而微微离地。
那滚烫得惊人的脸颊毫不避讳地紧紧贴上了他的胸膛，滚热的温度透过那一层薄薄的粗布衣衫，直直地烙在陆长生的皮肤上。
“几十年了……”
泪水像是决了堤的洪水，瞬间浸透了陆长生胸前那块粗糙的布料。

"Chenless..."
Two extremely slight words floated out from the deepest part of her throat. It was as light as a fleeting sigh, but it was actually wrapped up with a strong obsession and grievance that could not be resolved, and even a bit of resentment.
Lu Changsheng's whole body felt as if he had been struck by the Nine Heavens Mysterious Thunder. The blood all over his body instantly went cold. He froze in place and did not dare to move.
Dust-free? Jian Wuchen? The leader of the Heavenly Sword Sect who has been in seclusion all year round and whose divine dragon has never seen its tail? !
After a moment's thought, Lu Changsheng felt a chill on the back of his neck, and his scalp exploded instantly. There were no lights in the room, and I was standing by the door with backlight. I could just barely make out the outline of a tall figure.
In addition, his figure is indeed somewhat similar to the portrait of the sect leader hanging in the main hall.
At this moment, Liu Shishi had been knocked out of her mind by the chaotic Yin and Yang energy. Under this inhuman pain and hallucination, she thought that the black shadow at the door was the husband she thought about day and night. It was completely normal!
But this damn misunderstanding can kill people!
An extremely cold air rushed up to Tianling Gai along his tailbone.
If this aunt is really used as a substitute, when she wakes up afterwards, or is caught by an elder who wakes up at night, even if Lu Changsheng has ten lives, he will not be able to fill it! He will definitely be skinned alive and cramped, and his soul will be banished to the Netherworld and never be reincarnated.
"No... no! Madam, please see more clearly!" Lu Changsheng was so frightened that his voice cracked, and his tone sounded a bit more miserable than that of an old duck being strangled by his neck.
He kicked his feet randomly on the floor and shrank back as hard as he could, wishing that his whole body would be embedded in the door panel behind him. "I'm really not a sword..."
However, before the second half of the explanation could roll out of his throat, the scene in front of him suddenly became distorted.
There was no room for him to blink or react. It was a terrifying speed that completely exceeded the limit of what the naked eye could capture.
A skinny camel is bigger than a horse. Even if he is in the Nascent Soul stage, who is confused and on the verge of going crazy, the movement skills that he can instinctively burst out are definitely not something that a low-level ant like him, who is still struggling in the Qi refining stage, can spy on.
Lu Changsheng only felt that the curled up white shadow in front of him swayed like a ghost, and was torn apart in an instant from a distance of several feet.
A gust of fragrant wind mixed with the cold fragrance of orchids and scalding heat waves, with a dizzying suffocating feeling, reached the tip of his nose without warning.
The next moment, a huge shadow appeared under his hood.
Before Lu Changsheng could instinctively raise his arms to block, a delicate body that was incredibly soft but as hot as hot coals had just slammed into his arms, completely unreasonably.
"Bang!"
The force of the collision was so shocking that Lu Changsheng was knocked backwards and his back hit the hardwood door frame firmly.
All his internal organs seemed to shift at this moment, and he was so shocked that he almost lost his breath, and even the air in his lungs was forced out.
"You are finally willing to come out of seclusion... Do you know how hard I have been waiting for you?"
Just as Lu Changsheng was about to open his mouth, he struggled to squeeze out a sentence: "Madam, I..."
But Master Liu would never give him half a word of explanation.
Her hands were originally clawing at the carpet due to pain, and her fingertips were already bloody. Now, it was like a drowning person who was about to die and finally grabbed a piece of driftwood to save her life. With a suffocating force, she tightly wrapped her arms around Lu Changsheng's neck.
Her whole body was almost completely hanging on him, and her feet were even slightly off the ground due to the lack of strength.
The shockingly hot cheek pressed tightly against his chest without hesitation, and the hot temperature penetrated the thin layer of coarse cloth and burned directly onto Lu Changsheng's skin.
"It's been decades..."
The tears were like a flood that burst the embankment, instantly soaking into the rough fabric on Lu Changsheng's chest.
